visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use strstr
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two loops and a match flag look for a word in a sentence. Replace them with strstr and compute the index from the returned pointer. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: strstr returns a pointer to the first match or NULL. Subtracting the start of the text turns the pointer into an index. The library function is shorter and well tested.
